milestones.title: Research & Data Analysis
milestones.description: Analyzed hospital SOC alert patterns and benchmarked against the CIC IoMT 2024 and CICIDS 2017 datasets.

milestones.title: Core Scoring Engine
milestones.description: Built the Clinical Alert Score (CAS) engine, combining Random Forest, Isolation Forest, and K-Means.

milestones.title: Platform Integration
milestones.description: Connected the scoring engine to a Wazuh and Elasticsearch alert pipeline with a live dashboard.

milestones.title: Internal Validation & Benchmarking
milestones.description: Benchmarked ranking accuracy against traditional CVSS scoring across a range of simulated alert scenarios.

milestones.title: Public Launch Preparation
milestones.description: Finalizing documentation, security review, and launch readiness for the public platform.

milestones.title: General Availability
milestones.description: Opening MediSIEM and the CAAP scoring engine to early hospital partners.
